# Integration fixtures

These documents were created with Microsoft Word and are retained as external
compatibility samples. Tests may open, modify, save, and reload copies in memory, but
must not rewrite the fixture files in place.

| Fixture | Primary behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `documents/word-blank.docx` | Minimal Word-created package |
| `drawing/word-floating-picture.docx` | Anchored PNG with tight wrapping and explicit positioning |
| `images/word-svg-image.docx` | SVG image with Word-generated PNG fallback |
| `fonts/word-east-asian-fonts.docx` | Separate Latin and East Asian run fonts |
| `customxml/multiple-custom-xml-parts.docx` | Generated package with `item1` and `item3` plus data-store properties |

The Custom XML fixture is generated by `customxml/generate_fixture.py` from the
Word-created blank document. Run that script from the repository root to rebuild it.
